package main

import (
	"bytes"
	"crypto/sha256"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"testing"

	"github.com/waiting-here/NonbiriAPI/internal/db"
	"github.com/waiting-here/NonbiriAPI/internal/secret"
)

func TestWritePreviousTableFixtures(t *testing.T) {
	directory := os.Getenv("NONBIRI_PREVIOUS_TABLE_FIXTURES")
	if directory == "" {
		t.Fatal("missing fixture directory")
	}
	for _, game := range []string{"bidding", "likes"} {
		t.Run(game, func(t *testing.T) {
			f := newDuelWireFixture(t)
			mode := "quick"
			if game == "bidding" {
				mode = "tier1"
			}
			f.matched(game, mode)
			if err := f.app.Close(); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if _, err := f.store.DB().Exec(`VACUUM INTO ?`, filepath.Join(directory, game+".db")); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
		})
	}
}

func TestPreviousBinaryRejectsBlackjackUpgrade(t *testing.T) {
	directory := os.Getenv("NONBIRI_PREVIOUS_TABLE_FIXTURES")
	if directory == "" {
		t.Fatal("missing fixture directory")
	}
	vault, err := secret.New(bytes.Repeat([]byte{0x53}, secret.MasterKeyBytes))
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	defer vault.Close()
	for _, game := range []string{"bidding", "likes"} {
		path := filepath.Join(directory, game+"-upgraded.db")
		before, err := os.ReadFile(path)
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
		store, err := db.Open(path, vault)
		if store != nil {
			store.Close()
			t.Fatal("previous binary accepted newer storage")
		}
		if err == nil {
			t.Fatal("expected rejection")
		}
		after, err := os.ReadFile(path)
		if err != nil || sha256.Sum256(before) != sha256.Sum256(after) {
			t.Fatal("rejection wrote to source", err)
		}
	}
}
